# ClaudeSafe

> ClaudeSafe is an independent Windows utility for checking and monitoring the proxy/network environment used by Claude Desktop. It is not an Anthropic product.

## Project

- Website: https://ccsafe.lyzi.cloud/
- Source code: https://github.com/Jelee0145/ClaudeSafe
- Releases: https://github.com/Jelee0145/ClaudeSafe/releases
- Issues: https://github.com/Jelee0145/ClaudeSafe/issues

## What it does

- Checks local proxy connectivity before launching Claude Desktop.
- Checks outbound IP information and selected network/environment signals.
- Tests connectivity to Claude/Anthropic endpoints through the selected proxy.
- Uses a local Gatekeeper proxy to control requests routed through it.
- Monitors upstream proxy connectivity every 3 seconds and outbound IP changes every 15 seconds in the current implementation.
- Locks the controlled proxy path when a monitored network anomaly is detected.

## Platform

- Windows 10 / Windows 11, x64.
- Built with .NET 8 and WPF.
- Current website release information: v1.0.2. Check GitHub Releases for the latest version.

## Important limitations

- ClaudeSafe is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Anthropic.
- It cannot guarantee that a Claude account will not be restricted or banned.
- Periodic monitoring means there can be a delay between a network change and its detection.
- Proxy launch arguments and environment variables do not prove that every network request from every Claude Desktop component is routed through Gatekeeper. Coverage should be independently tested.

## Documentation

See the README on GitHub for the feature overview, build instructions, release downloads, and FAQ:
